name: com.gamecore.gameplay.interaction
description: Catalog row 5 of the gameplay plugin library (P1.3): interactables and triggers. Kernel half: the interaction plugin with the interact.state, uses, cooldownMs (and occupants) slots, the interact.use{actor,target}, interact.setState and interact.trigger routes and the InteractionSucceeded/InteractionRefused{code}/InteractableStateChanged/TriggerEntered/TriggerExited events; a DisableAutoCreation system applies the pure interaction rules, evaluating condition refs through IConditionEvaluator (null: always allowed, a locked door stays locked) and counting cooldowns down per step. Presentation: InteractableBinder (collider, per-state look), the interaction dispatcher (player.interact on a focused interactable becomes interact.use; committed successes run action refs through IActionRunner and cues through IFeedbackSink), TriggerVolume and ProximityInteractor (trigger enter/exit from committed positions). Authoring: InteractableDefinition (door/gate/examinable/point/switch, states, prompts, condition and action refs), TriggerDefinition, InteractionRoster; Editor tools interaction.addDoor/addExaminable/addTrigger, interaction.setStates, interaction.linkCondition and the interaction validator.
